name: vantage-productivity
description: Vantage Productivity: six desktop document editors and Vantage Mail

scripts.test: npm run test:format && npm run test -w @vantage/i18n && npm run test -w @vantage/electron-utils && npm run test -w @vantage/font-metrics && npm run test -w @vantage/zip-gate && npm run test -w @vantage/docx-engine && npm run test -w @vantage/pdf2docx && npm run test -w @vantage/html2docx && npm run test -w @vantage/file-parse && npm run test -w @vantage/pptx-engine && npm run test -w @vantage/xlsx-gateway && npm run test -w @vantage/pptx-ops && npm run test -w @vantage/pptx-render && npm run test -w @vantage/pipelines && npm run test -w @vantage/ai-search && npm run test -w @vantage/agent-core && npm run test -w @vantage/ai-provider && npm run test -w @vantage/project-store && npm run test -w @vantage/cli && npm run test -w @vantage/ui && npm run test -w @vantage/docs && npm run test -w @vantage/sheets && npm run test -w @vantage/shell && npm run test -w @vantage/slides && npm run test -w @vantage/pdf && npm run test -w @vantage/markdown && npm run test -w @vantage/html && npm run test -w @vantage/productivity-engine && node --test packages/engine-bridge/tests/bridge.test.mjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @vantage/i18n && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/electron-utils && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/font-metrics && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/zip-gate && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/docx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/pdf2docx && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/html2docx && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/file-parse && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/pptx-engine && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/xlsx-gateway && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/pptx-ops && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/pptx-render && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/pipelines && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/ai-search && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/agent-core && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/ai-provider && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/project-store && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/cli && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/ui && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/docs && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/sheets && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/shell && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/slides && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/pdf && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/markdown && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/html && npm run typecheck -w @vantage/productivity-engine
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n docs,sheets,slides,pdf,markdown,html,shell -c blue,green,yellow,red,cyan,white,magenta "npm run dev:renderer -w @vantage/docs" "npm run dev:renderer -w @vantage/sheets" "npm run dev:renderer -w @vantage/slides" "npm run dev:renderer -w @vantage/pdf" "npm run dev:renderer -w @vantage/markdown" "npm run dev:renderer -w @vantage/html" "cross-env DOCS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5173 SHEETS_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5174 SLIDES_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5175 PDF_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5176 MARKDOWN_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5177 HTML_RENDERER_URL=http://localhost:5178 npm run dev -w @vantage/shell"
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @vantage/docs && npm run build -w @vantage/sheets && npm run build -w @vantage/slides && npm run build -w @vantage/pdf && npm run build -w @vantage/markdown && npm run build -w @vantage/html && npm run build -w @vantage/cli && npm run build -w @vantage/shell
scripts.dist:mac: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run native:build:universal -w @vantage/sheets && npm run dist:mac -w @vantage/shell
scripts.dist:win: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:win -w @vantage/shell
scripts.dist:linux: npm run notices && npm run build:all && npm run dist:linux -w @vantage/shell
scripts.test:implementation: npm run test -w @vantage/engine-bridge && npm run test -w @vantage/productivity-engine && npm run test -w @vantage/electron-utils && npm run test -w @vantage/shell
